about: Mystery intake, Nov 5 (next round A): 389 outside-agent answers (Fable 299 / Opus 57 / Sonnet 33) + 13 JP MLIT A10 crosswalk joins = 402 rows (JP 36: 23 agent rows + 13 crosswalk rows, all held); 6 WDPA-sourced rows rejected, so 408 input rows, as NORMAL BOT FINDS for the waiting room, not overrides: answer blank, decided_by blank, bot_says is only the bot's proposal. Approval: Brandon 7:57 AM CST Nov 5, relayed via Super ('send everything you can to the bots'). Outline ruling: Brandon's own words, relayed via Super, 8:00 AM CST Nov 5: WA DBCA (CC BY-NC 4.0) outlines may be published, each labelled 'CC BY-NC 4.0, DBCA' and kept out of the repo licence (KPC-Links data/CREDITS-NC.md); Newfoundland, Colorado CNHP and South Africa SAPAD stay matching-only (ids, no outlines); Tokyo approximate-boundary flag, no outlines (no Tokyo rows in this batch); MLIT A10 ids only; CONANP rows would carry 'Fuente: CONANP' (none in this batch). Checks run on every row before it went in: rule 18 (kpc_precheck.rule18_differs + 'No.' numbers), the 5 km pin rule (the agent's measured distance), the kind/water check (pre-check TAGS + water words), banned sources (rule 3). 'intake' = accepted (bot_says YES) or held (bot_says NOT SURE, with intake_why). Rejected rows are NOT here (WDPA source); see the bundle's intake-rejected.csv. No answer bot applies a row with a blank answer. v2 re-cut (Quality grade, Nov 5): AU-2209, CA-0037 and US-9473 held (no pin distance, no registry id; AU-2209's candidate unchecked) and PT-0318 held (the official SDF has a centre point only and does not clearly confirm the park); FR-3611 (already held) also carries the new one-side-number rule 18 reason. The 7 NTWA covenant rows (AU-7112, 7113, 7114, 7115, 7117, 7118, 7559) are CAPAD (DCCEEW, CC BY 4.0), not DBCA: published with the CAPAD credit (Brandon's answers, 'Yes, go with your picks', relayed via Super, 8:55 AM CST Nov 5). Now 169 accepted, 233 held.
